info.name: Athkar API
info.description: Import this collection and Athkar.local.postman_environment.json, then select that environment. Set base_url (no trailing slash), mobile credentials and admin credentials locally. Secrets are intentionally empty in exports. Mobile and admin are separate top-level folders. Admin: CSRF Cookie -> Login -> selected request; cookie jar must stay enabled. Mobile: Register/Login captures mobile_token, Create Guest Identity captures guest_token. Create operations capture separate owned IDs. Sample numeric defaults are Quran references only; set public content IDs to existing published records. Set optional media paths from successful uploads. All mutation requests are explicit: do not run the whole collection against production. No requests were executed while creating this collection. Scripts assert success status and capture response values without logging secrets. Postman cookie scripting reference: https://learning.postman.com/latest-v-12/docs/tests-and-scripts/write-scripts/postman-sandbox-reference/pm-cookies

item.name: Admin Dashboard
item.description: Run Authentication / CSRF Cookie, then Login. Keep the Postman cookie jar enabled. Uses session cookies, never a bearer token. Requires an existing administrator and endpoint-specific permissions.

request.description: Run first. Postman stores the session and XSRF cookies. The response script captures the decoded token for browser writes. Keep the cookie jar enabled.
Requires access-dashboard. For initial setup, register an account then explicitly run php artisan admin:bootstrap <email> on the server. Session authentication does not issue a bearer token.
